_comment: 100x scale-down of the :aws_clt shape so the M5 / a laptop can host the whole stack in a Colima VM. message_count=90 + interval=1 gives each user a 90s sending session; pre_sampling_wait_s=20 skips the spawn+connect ramp; measurement_duration_s=45 stays inside the steady-state plateau before the earliest users finish. Numbers from :local are dev/smoke only — they don't ship to the public dashboard.
